decisions.reason: On 17 November 2026 the user reviewed the fifteen-collection queue and accepted a reordered sequence. Of about 7,277 repository keys, 1,609 carry a description, 2,747 a last-push date and 231 a native ID; about 2,145 appear only in the Drexel collection and 899 only in Lehigh, Scranton or Christiana. The six-work catalog averages about 4.5 KB per record against a 128,000-byte response bound. These are counts read from the queue and catalog, not a qualified yield or a tested page size.
decisions.choice: Follow execution_sequence. Enrich the primary-region queue through one qualified provider metadata route and measure admission yield on about 100 leads before building a review interface or changing the homepage. Add a private candidate review interface as a GL08 scope addition, distinct from GL08's correction and upkeep work. Build GL06 cards and search on one renderer and switch the homepage once the admitted catalog is large enough to browse. Pause new collection intake except gap-driven searches. This supersedes the concurrent GL06/GL08 start in GL05-D01; package dependencies and acceptance criteria are unchanged. It grants no acquisition request scope, source enrollment or release.
